title: Hunt for treasures at Tucson’s gem shows
description: Every winter, Tucson fills with dealers, collectors, and makers showing minerals, fossils, gems, and jewelry. Move from glittering display cases to rough stones with their origins still visible; ask questions and learn how a specimen reached the table. The showcase spans many venues, so pick a few that match your curiosity and give yourself time to browse.
teaser: Wander from raw crystals to fossils and handmade jewelry.
goodToKnow: Check the latest showcase calendar; shows span many venues, so choose a few that match your interests.
whyItMightDelightYou: It rewards curiosity even if you buy nothing: each table opens a small window onto geology and craft.
